metadata.title: Asymmetric L-space knots with arbitrary braid index
metadata.abstract: The first examples of asymmetric L-space knots were found by Baker and Luecke. Among Baker-Luecke knots, the simplest one has braid index 12. Later, it turned out that there are just 9 asymmetric hyperbolic L-space knots in the SnapPy census, and their braid indices take the values 4, 5, 6 and 7. It is known that asymmetric L-space knots have braid index at least 4. Recently, Baker and the second author give infinitely many asymmetric hyperbolic L-space knots with braid index 4. In this paper, we construct an asymmetric hyperbolic L-space knot with arbitrary braid index bigger than 4. In fact, there exist infinitely many such knots for each braid index.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 任意高辫子指数的非对称 L-space 结
analysis.workSummary: 对每个大于四的辫子指数，构造无穷多个非对称双曲 L-space 结。
analysis.breakthrough: 补齐此前指数四实例之后所有更高辫子指数的存在性。
analysis.limitations: 是指定指数的构造与无穷性结果，不是非对称 L-space 结的完整分类。
